title: Random Stuffs
body:
A mod that add random stuffs like **Blocks,Items,Mobs and much more.** 

**(NOTE: currently there is only blocks and items)**

**Items:**
- Cooked coal
- Raw zinc
- zinc

**Blocks:**
- Zinc block


Im a noob at modding so this is my first time and im using tutorial. Yeah :3

But after the future, i will be good and start updating and adding cool stuff.


### UPDATE 1.1:

- Added Zinc and Zinc block: Zinc armor coming to the future.

- Added Recipe for Cooked coal and Raw zinc.
